_help: Edit this file to manage your projects. cat must be one of: ue (Unreal), unity (Unity), other. engine, role and year are optional and are hidden when empty. The about, skills and contact keys at the bottom feed the About, Toolbox and Contact sections. Remove "placeholder": true once a project is real. Optional "image": a path or data URI to use a screenshot/GIF instead of the node sketch.

about: I'm a gameplay programmer interested in everything between the player pressing a button and the screen responding: controls, states, camera, combat and AI.
I work in both Unreal Engine and Unity, and I like to leave systems tidy so the design team can tweak them without fear.
